summary.allegation: The cardholder disputes a 215.00 EUR charge from Hotel Marais Saint-Paul described as a no-show fee, asserting the charge is not valid.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show the cardholder's booking, the no-show/cancellation policy disclosed at booking, proof the cardholder failed to show or cancelled late, and that the amount charged matches that policy.

requirements.title: Original booking
requirements.text: Evidence of the cardholder's original reservation or booking.
requirements.finding: Booking confirmation MSP-2025-4488 in the name of K. Adler shows a Classic Double for one night, check-in 26 April 2025, at 215.00 EUR paid by Mastercard ending 4421 — matching the disputed 215.00 EUR transaction at MCC 7011.

requirements.title: Policy disclosed at booking
requirements.text: The merchant's no-show / cancellation policy as disclosed at booking.
requirements.finding: The cancellation policy document states the non-refundable rate is charged in full at booking with no refund for no-show, and records tick-box acceptance by the guest on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET under consent_id cns_4488a, the same date as the booking.

citations.quote: Non-refundable bookings are charged in full at the time of booking. No refund will be issued for cancellation, modification, no-show, or early departure.
Guest accepted this policy on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET via tick-box consent on the booking page (consent_id: cns_4488a).

requirements.title: No-show or late cancellation
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder either failed to show or cancelled outside the policy window.
requirements.finding: The front desk log for booking MSP-2025-4488 records the guest as an expected arrival at 15:00 on 26 April 2025, not arrived at 22:00 with no contact, and formally marked NO-SHOW at 00:30 on 27 April after the midnight cut-off. No cancellation was recorded at any point.

alerts.text: D1 states the 215.00 EUR was "charged at booking" on 12 March 2025, but the transaction record dates the 215.00 EUR authorisation/settlement to 2025-04-26T11:00Z (the stay date). The amount and card match, but the merchant should explain the charge-date discrepancy if the issuer raises it.

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence

justification: All four requirements are supported by matching booking, policy acceptance, no-show log and an exact amount match, on a fully 3DS-authenticated transaction.
rationale: The cardholder disputes a 215.00 EUR no-show fee from Hotel Marais Saint-Paul (txn_9967QR). The merchant has produced booking confirmation MSP-2025-4488 in the name of K. Adler for a Classic Double on 26-27 April 2025 at a non-refundable rate of 215.00 EUR paid on Mastercard ending 4421, together with the cancellation policy the guest accepted by tick-box on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET (consent_id cns_4488a), which expressly provides that no refund is issued for a no-show. The front desk log for the same booking reference records the guest as not arrived at 22:00 on 26 April with no contact, marked NO-SHOW at 00:30 on 27 April after the midnight cut-off, and the room released at 07:15 with the fee retained per the non-refundable terms. The amount retained equals the full booked rate of 215.00 EUR, exactly matching the disputed transaction, which was 3DS-authenticated with AVS 'Y' and CVV 'M'. The no-show fee was validly assessed in line with the policy disclosed and accepted at booking; the chargeback should be represented.
